title: Handover agents
description: agents.json in a frozen handover (handovers/<id>/), written only when the model has agents: the agents of the design described neutrally, for whatever turns a design into an agent contract. Written by Core.handoverAgents at freeze, listed and hashed in handover.yaml (agents:) but outside the handover id. It names no contract language. designc owns this contract; consumers conform to it. docs/handover-agents.example.json is the shared fixture.

agents.description: Elements tagged Agent or declaring d.agent.autonomy, in model order.

id.description: Hierarchical element id, the same as in elements.json.

tools.description: Non-structural relationships the agent takes part in. A property appears only where the model declares it; absent means undeclared, never a default.

direction.description: out: the agent calls other. in: other calls the agent.

other.description: Hierarchical element id of the other end.
